verdict.rationale: Dropbox's own developer docs cover scoped credentials: a first-party article on "Customizing scopes in the OAuth app authorization flow" and an OAuth guide, which suggests apps (including agents) can be granted limited permissions. The evidence is only article titles, so the depth and granularity of least-privilege control is unproven. missing for 10: detail on the available scopes and how fine-grained they are, how to issue, rotate and revoke tokens for a non-human agent, folder/path-restricted access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
